name: Simon Fraser University
description: Simon Fraser University is a public research university founded in 1965, with campuses in Burnaby, Surrey and Vancouver, British Columbia. It includes the Beedie School of Business and the Faculty of Applied Sciences.
whyIncluded: Simon Fraser University is among the 10 universities in Canada most chosen by international students (3,562 international undergraduate programme FTEs in 2024/25), per the FinexisEdu shortlist research of October 2026.

livingCosts.summary: The university's own estimate for an international first-year student in a residence room with meal plan over two terms (8 months); transit pass is in student fees.
livingCosts.notes: SFU admission 'fees and scholarships' page, 2026/27 international estimate for one academic year (two terms, 30 units): single residence room (North Towers) with meal plan C$15,014 (combined housing and food, so all in housing), textbooks, technology and supplies C$2,400 (personal). Transport 0: U-Pass is in tuition and fees (C$38,944). Medical insurance C$945 excluded.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Applied Science (BASc) in Engineering Science
programmes.summary: Annual tuition for new international students taking 30 units (10 courses) a year, plus compulsory student fees incl. transit pass. Fees can rise each year. Health insurance is extra.
programmes.notes: SFU 2026 Fall Calendar, undergraduate international tuition, 'Engineering Science, Mechatronic Systems, Sustainable Energy Engineering (premium - per unit)', for students who entered in 2024/2025 or later: C$1,348.19/unit x 30 units (full-time year). Compulsory = full-time student fees per term from the same Calendar page: student services 54.11 + recreation-athletics 90.14 + student activity 191.91 + U-Pass BC 191.40 = C$527.56 x 2 terms = C$1,055.12; opt-out extended health and dental and the international medical insurance (C$281/term) excluded. Cross-check: SFU's admission page estimates C$38,944 tuition and fees for an international student taking 30 units in 2026/27 (basic rate x 30 + these fees = C$38,941.52). Rates are per entry cohort but the Calendar notes they can change; earlier Calendars (2024, 2025) are not readable, so no history.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Science (BSc) in Computing Science
programmes.summary: Year 1 costs about C$37,900 (30 units at the basic rate); years 2 to 4 cost about C$39,839 a year at the Computing Science rate. Compulsory student fees of about C$1,055 a year included; health insurance is extra. Not fixed.
programmes.notes: SFU 2026 Fall Calendar, undergraduate international tuition, 'School of Computing Science (200/300/400 divisions) (premium - per unit)', for students who entered in 2024/2025 or later: C$1,327.97/unit x 30 units (full-time year). The premium rate applies to 200-400 division Computing Science courses; first-year (100-division) courses are charged the basic rate (C$1,262.88/unit), so year 1 costs less. Compulsory = full-time student fees per term from the same Calendar page: student services 54.11 + recreation-athletics 90.14 + student activity 191.91 + U-Pass BC 191.40 = C$527.56 x 2 terms = C$1,055.12; opt-out extended health and dental and the international medical insurance (C$281/term) excluded. Cross-check: SFU's admission page estimates C$38,944 tuition and fees for an international student taking 30 units in 2026/27 (basic rate x 30 + these fees = C$38,941.52). Rates are per entry cohort but the Calendar notes they can change; earlier Calendars (2024, 2025) are not readable, so no history. laterYears added 2026-10-08 from the figures above; annualTuition is now the year-1 figure.
